answer: An identity's standing is the violet marks its clients sign on its thread, each worth more as the thread ages, so weight grows faster than tenure. A clone has to buy clients: it pays them quartz to deal with it. Each client deals with one identity per epoch, so every clone queued behind real business bids a higher price, and the thousandth clone pays many times the first for marks it cannot share. An honest newcomer's first mark is signed free by a client who wanted the work. A fresh wallet buys nothing.
